title: Orbital Remnants Manual
summary: Prepare suits, oxygen, shuttle routes, and salvage plans before entering offworld pressure.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Orbital Remnants shifts survival upward: pressure, oxygen, shuttle access, faction pledges, suit modules, and route commitment all matter.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Check oxygen reserves, suit integrity, return route, and emergency supplies before boarding anything that can strand you away from base.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Prepare suit systems, travel to the remnant, salvage a focused target, manage pressure or oxygen loss, return, and convert orbital parts into better gear.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Suit modules, sealant patches, oxygen cells, emergency rockets, shuttle items, and route vessels describe what kind of trip you are ready to survive.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Stationfall shares pressure logic, Recovery helps after failed routes, HoloMap and Terminal track destinations, and Armory improves away-team readiness.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If orbital routes fail, do not add more objectives. Add more oxygen, repair capability, navigation clarity, and a shorter extraction plan.
